verdict.rationale: smolagents is a Python library that you pip install and run in your own environment. It can run with local transformers or ollama models, so the core product and even the LLM can be fully self-hosted without a vendor service. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, dedicated self-hosting/deployment documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of fully local operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: `smolagents` is a library that enables you to run powerful agents in a few lines of code.
pip install 'smolagents[toolkit]'  # Includes default tools like web search
It can be a local `transformers` or `ollama` model
we have re-built a more secure `LocalPythonExecutor` from the ground up.
